name: Cheese, Apple & Potato Pasties
subtitle: Buttery pastry filled with tender potato, tart apple, and grated cheese.
description: Make individual pasties with a crisp butter pastry and a savory-sweet filling of thinly sliced potato, apple, and hard cheese.

ingredients.item: plain flour plus extra for dusting
Granny Smith apples peeled and sliced
hard cheese grated (Lincolnshire Poacher or Cornish cheddar work well)

instructions.text: Cut the cold butter into the flour and work it together until the mixture is firm and forms a dough. Chill for 20 minutes.
Divide the chilled dough into six portions. Roll each portion on a lightly floured surface into a round, then chill the rounds for 15 minutes.
Combine the sliced potatoes, apples, and grated cheese for the filling.
Place filling on one half of each pastry round, leaving a border. Fold the dough over and seal the edges firmly, then transfer the pasties to a baking tray.
Chill the assembled pasties for 30 minutes while the oven preheats.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the potato is tender when pierced at the center.
